svg.title: SLOs & Error Budgets
svg.desc: SLOs & Error Budgets. Measure SLIs against an objective and alert on error-budget burn rate, not on every blip. Step 1, SLI and SLO: Each response counts as good or bad. SLI = good ÷ valid = 99.95%, above the 99.9% objective. Step 2, The error budget: The 0.1% that may fail is the budget: 30,000 requests. A 5-minute blip burns 1.2%: no page. Step 3, Alert on burn rate: 1.5% errors burn the budget at 15×. Once the 1 h and 5 min windows both pass 14.4×, it pages. Step 4, Spend it on purpose: Budget left: keep shipping. Budget spent: freeze features until old errors age out of the window.

g.text: Each response counts as good or bad. SLI = good ÷ valid = 99.95%, above the 99.9% objective.
The 0.1% that may fail is the budget: 30,000 requests. A 5-minute blip burns 1.2%: no page.
1.5% errors burn the budget at 15×. Once the 1 h and 5 min windows both pass 14.4×, it pages.
Budget left: keep shipping. Budget spent: freeze features until old errors age out of the window.
good ÷ valid, counted at the load balancer
as time: 43.2 min of total outage per 30 days
background errors: about 20 requests an hour
blip: 5 min at 10% errors = about 350 requests (1.2%)
incident: 1.5% errors burn the budget 15× too fast
risky launches: a slow 2× burn spends the rest
budget spent, 3,000 requests over: SLO missed
old errors age out of the 30-day window
the budget refills: back within the SLO
5 min spikes to 100×, 1 h only to 8.8×: no page
both windows over 14.4× after 58 min: page
fixed: the 5 min window clears, the page stops
3 d and 6 h windows over 1×: ticket
budget left: ship features, run experiments
budget left: ship features, run experiments
budget spent: freeze features, fix reliability
budget spent: freeze features, fix reliability
